metadata.description: Lab marketplace for plugin R&D tooling — instruments for testing, measuring, and iterating Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Teaching entry point for the marketplace: explains both stages in plain language — Prospector (discovery: what is worth building at all) and Optimizer (A/B measurement: does it actually help) — how they chain via a pre-written mandate, and why the dod-lite auditor is a separate plugin. Ships no workflow steps and writes no files.

plugins.name: optimizer
plugins.description: Control-vs-plugin A/B testing harness: creates experiment environments, fires paired sessions with everything-else-equal configs, analyzes both session JSONLs + DoD logs + human verdict into an evidence-backed improvement report.

plugins.name: prospector
plugins.description: Discovery-stage counterpart to the Optimizer: starts from ambiguity rather than a spec. Interviews for evidence instead of accepting the stated issue, keeps competing problem framings alive, tracks hypotheses with explicit confidence, and builds deliberately narrow MVP plugins whose real use is the primary evidence. Hands a validated direction to the Optimizer as a pre-written mandate.

plugins.name: dod-lite
plugins.description: Internal audit instrument for optimizer arm sessions: runs Definition-of-Done checks silently at Stop and records a per-turn report. Observational only — it never speaks to the session it observes. Registered so it installs alongside optimizer; not intended for standalone use.
